thought:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: production transparent animation spritesheet, not a storyboard or contact sheet for presentation.
Input 1 is the character identity and writing-pose reference. Input 2 is the existing coarse motion reference. Create a much finer, smoothly progressive animation of THIS EXACT fox-masked shrine clerk seated, facing LEFT in 3/4 side view. Match illustration texture and costume, long BLACK hair with red tie, ivory shrine sleeves, muted vermilion hakama, white fox mask worn over FRONT of face. One complete anatomically connected person per cell.
Output a clean EXACT 6 COLUMN x 4 ROW grid =24 animation cels, row-major order, evenly spaced invisible rectangular cells on TRUE TRANSPARENT background. Wide landscape canvas. No visible grid, numbers, captions, floor, table, stool, shadows or props except the ONE held slender calligraphy brush. Whole seated figure including feet in every cell. Same scale, same hip position, identical feet baseline and identical unmoving hakama/knees/feet across ALL cells. Full margin on each cell, no overlapping cells. Camera absolutely stationary. Each successive frame should be a small change, no duplicate full rows.
Sequence:
cells0-3: start in reference writing posture; gradually lower right hand and rotate brush from upright into horizontal position toward desk at just above knee height, in front of her, LEFT of body.
cells4-5: fingertips release the horizontal brush at that exact location; brush disappears from sprites once released because it belongs on the scene's tabletop.
cells6-8: EMPTY right hand gently withdraws and rises toward her chest; left hand lifts slightly from her lap. Both wrists always join complete sleeves.
cells9-11: both forearms gradually fold across FRONT of chest into comfortable arms-crossed thoughtful pose; elbows remain connected to shoulders, hands tuck naturally.
cells12-13: settled arms-crossed, head gently tilted a little up as if thinking, face still covered with fox mask.
cells14-17: reverse folding naturally, uncross both arms gradually.
cells18-20: EMPTY right hand extends down-left to the previously placed horizontal brush, left hand returns to lap; fingers close around the resting brush only at cell20.
cells21-23: brush now held; lift it gradually and rotate back to reference upright diagonal writing pose. Cell23 closely matches cell0.
Style: exact same fine textured illustrated pixel-art as reference, tiny character intended for a detailed lofi scene, no new anime rendering. Keep head size/costume/hip/feet shape consistent. Important: visibly distinct small intermediate ARM positions, not eight poses repeated three times. No extra limbs, no detached arms, no distorted hands. Only arms and slight head tilt change; lower body remains a single fixed shape.
nap:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: production transparent animation spritesheet.
Input 1 is exact identity and standard seated body reference. Input 2 shows target rest gesture, not its coarse timing. Make a fine continuous motion sequence of this exact small shrine clerk sitting facing LEFT, long BLACK hair red tie, ivory sleeves, muted vermilion hakama, white red fox mask fully covering FRONT of face.
EXACT 6 COLUMN x 4 ROW =24 animation cels, uniform invisible rectangular grid, row-major. Landscape canvas. Genuinely transparent background alpha, no shadows, furniture, captions, gridlines, text or brush. Each cell whole seated person, same fixed camera/scale. Feet and hakama/lap/knees IDENTICAL in all cells, same hip position and foot baseline, generous margin, no overlap. Her tabletop is in front of her at slightly ABOVE her knees; imagine the desk but DON'T draw furniture.
Cells0-3: upright with empty hands resting at desk height, slowly extend both forearms forward to form a soft pillow ON THE DESK, toward LEFT, not on lap.
Cells4-9: gradually hinge torso forward from hips and lower neck/head, mask turns downward, keep both shoulder-to-elbow-to-wrist connections fully drawn. Forearms stay at fixed desk height, knees do NOT rise.
Cells10-12: final sleepy posture, head/mask cheek resting face-DOWN on folded ivory forearms on invisible desk, hair falls naturally behind shoulder, unmistakably asleep at a desk.
Cells13-20: carefully reverse the forward hinge, head lifts first then torso gradually straightens. Arms separate and remain gently on desk/lap.
Cells21-23: upright again, empty hands at desk height, cell23 matches cell0.
Critical: each successive cell a SMALL intermediate movement, not just four poses repeated. Smooth natural arc of spine and head. Preserve lower body shape and scale, do not resize sleeping cels to fill the cell. No standing, stretching, doors, stamping, extra limbs or broken wrists. Same fine textured illustrated pixel-art treatment as reference. No smooth anime face, no human face exposed.
